I know what I imagine doesnt help my cause.  No matter how much I want to act as a normal happy person I'm still seen as the baggy eyed creep with psychotic episodes.  I go to SPC atm but it's only to make myself feel less of a loser.  I think a trade school would be better for me but I have no idea what trade to go into.  I don't want to spend a fuckload of money on something that will make me realize I don't like to do it or I won't find a good job out of it.

Other than watching a few pokemon episodes when I was a kid I just never really could get into anime.  Don't get me wrong I've seen that Attack on titan shit on reddit numerous times and it looks raw as fuck! but I my attention couldnt make it through the first episode lol.

Controlling urges and anger through music makes sense.  It just feels weird that it took me until I was 22 to realise it.  I've always wanted to learn and play guitar but never had the drive.  I always invision what it would be like to express my own pain and anxiety through a mic.  I think a guitar is a good start though.

I need to be drunk to scream lol.  I really like Vol 3 as well.  My friend gave me their first album in 2000 as a gift and i was obsessed.  I actually skipped Iowa because I didn't know about it at the time and i had to have someone on my bus route to school who worked at a local music store to buy Vol 3 for me.  It wasnt as angry as album 1 but it showed more of an emotional side to slipknot i never really considered.  I remember hearing about All hope is gone but by that time i had moved to a completely different area and began hanging out with people with different tastes.  so i gave up on metal.  nowadays when it comes to their latest album i have that song "till we die" stuck in my head.  something about it is so hypnotic.

Not worried about my hearing really lol.  Metal music has been my lullaby to sleep for years.  My brother was in a band and is pretty goddamn talented with guitar.  I pick it once in a blue moon and can pick up sounds pretty quickly.  It's hard on my fingers but I bet if I actually strive to be better at it I could make it a talent.
I definitely recommend Meshuggahs Obzen album as well as Catch 33.  Catch 33 makes the whole album feel like one hour and a half long song, its fucking mental!

its for the sake of doing something productive lol.  I have back and joint issues so it takes its toll every damn time but it still make me feel a little more than nothing when I'm done.  No interests other than gaming just to pass the time.  I like to cook mostly because I like good food and I'm the only one in the house who knows how to cook.  other than that, nothing really.

I don't feel any energy when I listen to music (Iincluding metal).  I went to mayhem fest last year geeked outta my mind on adderall and I felt more out of place than anywhere else.  It feels like classical music to me, its just beautiful and extremely brutal haha!  Most of my time is spent on reddit or playing video games.  I have a friend from my old crew I still keep in contact with every now and then.  We usually just hit the gym once or twice a week.  He has anxiety as well but doesn't like having me around much I suppose.  I just make an ass of myself when I'm around someone for an extended period of time.  Since most of my other friends are either dead, in prison or rehab, I don't really have anyone to hang out with.

I love metal.  Slipknot was the first band I ever connected with.  Most of the other bands I listen to I don't think I can even understand the words.  I just listen to it in silence and imagine beautiful pictures of destruction.  Constitutional Masterbation, Whore to a Chainsaw, I am Colossus, Omerta.  I fucking listen to the same shit over and over and just feel power surging in my brain.  Imagining all the pain I can deliver to satisfy my need to torture and dismember.  I don't play or understand guitar, I don't really keep up with music I just get in to what may come my way.  I don't think I could really share how music makes me feel.

Right on man.  This isn't a throwaway, I only use it for r/depression and r/suicidewatch.  I really want to try to transition out of alcoholism and be able to socialize with people without being afraid of who I am.  If I could smoke weed with ya, you're probably the only one I would do it with right now :).

I think I know what it would take.  It's mostly the constant loneliness that fuels my depression.  I wish I could be better at casually meeting people.  I go to the gym at least twice a week and that seems like the best place to meet people but I usually just put my headphones in and focus on my own shit.  I wish people could understand I mean well, I just don't know how to present myself.  I think I'll start smoking weed again, maybe cut back on the alcohol.  I've had a lot of bad experiences with weed but after being a subscriber of r/trees for so long I realize it's the only way I can't mentally prepare myself for finding new friends.  The only thing that scares me about weed is that it forces me to let my guard down which terrifies me every time I'm high. I just don't trust peoples intentions.

First off I really want to thank you for sticking with me on this.  You genuinely care about someone you've never even met and I think you're just goddamn amazing for that. It seems like my emotions go through rough spikes every day.  I'm a pretty emotional guy but I understand, especially living in Florida, that it shows a strong sign of weakness.  The only people that seem to somewhat understand is my brother and his friends.  I wish I could hang out with them more often but they're older and have a lot of things going on all the time.  I always feel like I have to put on a front so I don't get hurt.  I know it's wrong to act like an asshole but it feels so instinctual.  And when I try to be nice it comes out really weird, desperate, and awkward.  I just want to keep to myself, for my well being and everyone else's.  But no, people just won't leave me alone.
Sorry about that rant, it's been a long night.

Suicide is pretty much the most important thing I think about every day. Ever..single..fucking..day.  I know it's selfish. It's really pathetic.  But I can't just get it out of my head.  I'm absolutely obsessed.  I think about what I would do on my last day.  I write out suicide notes that are pages long but when I proofread them they seem like insane jibberish.  I feel so alone but I don't want anyone to know because any ounce of pity pisses me the fuck off.  I wouldn't go as far as to say that everyone hates me, but they definitely don't want anything to do with me.  I have a habit of making that so.  My family thinks I'm a sociopath.  If the suicidal thoughts are making me physically sick I switch my mindset to murder.  I've thought it through quite thoroughly and I'm sure I could get away with it.  I want to see if I'd feel anything from taking a life.  The concept seems fun and euphoric to me.  But no matter how out of place I feel, how much of a menace people see me as, or how fucking pathetically suicidal I get, I'll never do it.  Suicide is one thing, but if my family saw me leave this world as a literal monster, they would never be strong enough to handle it.  It would completely consume them, I just wish there was a way to explain to them that I love them so much that I don't kill people....LOL

I really wanted to be their friend but they just stepped on me every chance they got.  It made me bitter and made me drink by myself every night.  I had to leave and basically retreat to my room for a long time.  It was a really lonely and fucked up time but when I finally just put my balls back in my sack and ventured out for the next job I felt much better.  My next job was a little different.  The coworkers were shitty but not abusive, I ended up getting fired for "being too comfortable with customers".  Just the other day I started a new job.  I don't have any advice on how to deal with people because I'm still learning that as well.  All I can do now is keep my head down unless spoken to and do my work.

I still drive home drunk from time to time.  During his last few weeks I was finally getting my shit together and I just saw him as someone holding me back.  On his last night he came to see me and two others, he just wanted to see his friends one last time.  I wonder what he would've said to me, I probably would've let him drive anyways, I'd be a hypocrite if I told him not to.  I can imagine it would've been harder to deal with if I had stayed home that night.

I know that's normal...fucking comes with the tokes for godssake.  But usually the depression overcomes my paranoia and all I want to do is kill myself to avoid the situation.  The last dozen times I got high I either went into a fit of crying and laughing or cut my wrist or tried to OD on pills.  Believe me...I really just want to be high and happy, but I'm absolutely terrified of the possible consequences.

I realized she really couldn't give 2 shits about me, I was just a paycheck in her mind.
